summary: This note is a plot summary of the 2008 film Doubt, opening in 1964 at a Catholic church and school in The Bronx, New York. Father Flynn preaches on doubt as a unifying force, while Sister Aloysius, the strict school principal, grows suspicious after seeing a boy pull away from him in the courtyard. She alerts the other nuns to a possible problem at the school.
one_line: Plot summary of the 2008 film Doubt, set in a 1964 Bronx Catholic school where a principal suspects a priest.
key_facts: The film Doubt (2008) opens in 1964 at a Catholic church in The Bronx, New York.
Father Flynn gives a sermon on the nature of doubt, noting that like faith, doubt can be a unifying force.
Sister Aloysius is the strict principal of the parish school.
Sister Aloysius becomes concerned when she sees a boy pull away from Father Flynn in the school courtyard.
At dinner, Sister Aloysius asks her fellow nuns whether they know why Father Flynn would preach about doubt.
Sister Aloysius instructs the other nuns to be alert to a possible problem in the school.
